question: Why did the authors choose copper current collectors for the anode-free sodium cell?
rendered: The authors did not choose copper current collectors for the anode-free sodium cell. They actually chose aluminum (Al) current collectors instead of copper because Al offers significant cost and weight benefits, being ∼3× cheaper and ∼3× lighter than Cu.
